name: Return to Bodley
label: Quest
description: Return to Bodley: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I will ignore your impertinence this time, adventurer, because you have done a noble thing today; returning the rest of my stolen spirit to me. Despite your obviously weak nature, traveler, you have shown courage where those that stole from me did not, and probably never could!
Return to them, before I change my mind and slay you where you stand. Go back and tell them that they are safe... For now.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, you're back and still alive! Well, at least that makes one of us.
You're going to have to tell me all about it!

clips.title: Completion
paras: He really said all of that? Wow, I can't believe he's going to call off the spectral assassins and stalkers, even if he did hint at causing my living companions further harm in the future.
This is a great day, friend! You've accomplished what few ever could, and absolved us, at least in part, of some of our past sins.
Thank you! As a sign of appreciation, I'd like to give you this. You can use it to summon forth spirits at the same haunted locations that you already have, and a few others, too.
